description: While hover and focus color changes exist for links, there are no explicit :focus outline or ring styles for interactive elements. This makes keyboard navigation difficult as users cannot clearly see which element has focus.

phases.name: Add Focus Design Tokens
phases.description: Add CSS custom properties for focus styles to the design system, ensuring consistency across all focus indicators.

subtasks.title: Add focus-related CSS custom properties
subtasks.description: Add design tokens for focus ring color, offset, width, and style to the :root CSS custom properties section. Use a visible color that contrasts well with backgrounds (the accent color or a dedicated focus color).

phases.name: Base Focus Styles
phases.description: Add base focus-visible styles for generic interactive elements (links, buttons). Use :focus-visible to show focus indicators only for keyboard navigation, not mouse clicks.

subtasks.title: Add base link focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Update the base anchor (a) styles to include a visible focus ring using :focus-visible. Ensure the existing :focus color change is preserved and augmented with an outline.

subtasks.title: Add base button and input focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Add focus-visible styles for buttons, inputs, textareas, and select elements to ensure form controls have visible focus indicators.

phases.name: Navigation Focus Styles
phases.description: Add specific focus styles for navigation components including the logo, nav menu links, and hamburger button.

subtasks.title: Add nav-logo focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Add visible focus ring to the navigation logo link (.nav-logo) using :focus-visible with appropriate offset for padding.

subtasks.title: Add nav-menu link focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Add visible focus ring to navigation menu links (.nav-menu a) using :focus-visible, ensuring visibility on both desktop and mobile menu states.

subtasks.title: Add hamburger button focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Add visible focus ring to the hamburger menu button (.hamburger) using :focus-visible, ensuring the outline is visible against the background.

phases.name: Gallery Focus Styles
phases.description: Add focus styles for photo gallery interactive elements.

subtasks.title: Add photo gallery item focus styles
subtasks.description: Add visible focus ring to photo gallery items (.photo-gallery-item) for when they contain focusable elements, using :focus-within styles alongside existing transform effect.

subtasks.title: Add photo gallery credit link focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Add visible focus ring to photo credit links (.photo-gallery-credit a) using :focus-visible.

phases.name: Footer Focus Styles
phases.description: Add focus styles for footer navigation links.

subtasks.title: Add footer link focus-visible styles
subtasks.description: Add visible focus ring to footer navigation links (.footer-nav a) using :focus-visible, ensuring visibility against footer background.

phases.name: Testing and Verification
phases.description: Build the site and verify all focus indicators work correctly with keyboard navigation.

subtasks.title: Build the site and verify CSS compiles
subtasks.description: Run npm run build to ensure the site builds successfully with the new focus styles.

subtasks.title: Manual keyboard navigation testing
subtasks.description: Document testing of Tab key navigation through all interactive elements to verify focus indicators are visible and meet WCAG 2.1 requirements (minimum 3:1 contrast ratio for focus indicators).

final_acceptance: All interactive elements (links, buttons) have visible :focus-visible outlines/rings
Focus indicators use consistent styling from CSS custom properties
Focus indicators have sufficient contrast (minimum 3:1 ratio per WCAG 2.1)
Navigation elements (logo, menu links, hamburger) have visible focus states
Gallery items and credit links have visible focus states
Footer links have visible focus states
Site builds successfully with no CSS errors
Keyboard navigation (Tab, Shift+Tab) works through all focusable elements
notes: Using :focus-visible instead of :focus to show outlines only for keyboard navigation, not mouse clicks
The accent color (--color-tint: #FF1493) provides good visibility for focus rings
Footer styles don't exist yet in the CSS - will need to add focus styles as part of new footer section or inline with base styles
The site uses Georgia serif font and a clean white/black color scheme
Mobile hamburger menu has accessibility features (aria-expanded, escape key handling) but needs visible focus
